behavior: While a hover popup blocks the pointer events outside it, each trigger of the popup that opens on hover keeps its pointer events. The pointer can then move from the active trigger straight to another hover trigger, and the popup moves to that trigger with no close. Base UI gives pointer events only to the active trigger and the positioner. The leave event of a trigger then names no trigger, the safe polygon closes the popup, and the next trigger opens it again. The popup fades for some frames. In WebKit, the next trigger can get its enter event about 200 ms later. A popup with a shorter exit then unmounts and mounts again. A leave to a trigger that does not open on hover closes the popup as a leave to any other element. Base UI takes each enabled trigger as the next owner, so a hover popover stays open after the pointer leaves a trigger that opens it only on a press. Hover triggers and positioners keep their author pointer styles. A foreign scope recovers its prior inline value and priority after the last block. Base UI removes these inline values.
